theme: 3 terms on error handling: when code can fail

terms.definition: A keyword that stops a function and sends out an error.
terms.example: Throw an error if the password is wrong.

terms.definition: A keyword you write before a call that can throw an error.
terms.example: Add try before this call, because it can fail.

terms.definition: A block that runs risky code and handles any error it throws.
terms.example: Wrap it in do-catch, so the app does not crash.

video.description:
Learn to talk about error handling in Swift: Throw, Try and Do-Catch, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Throw - A keyword that stops a function and sends out an error.
Try - A keyword you write before a call that can throw an error.
Do-Catch - A block that runs risky code and handles any error it throws.

Explain Throw, Try and Do-Catch in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
에러 던지기, try, do-catch 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Throw - A keyword that stops a function and sends out an error.
한국어: 함수를 멈추고 에러를 내보내는 키워드

Try - A keyword you write before a call that can throw an error.
한국어: 에러를 던질 수 있는 호출 앞에 쓰는 키워드

Do-Catch - A block that runs risky code and handles any error it throws.
한국어: 위험한 코드를 실행하고 던져진 에러를 처리하는 블록

dialogue.title: When the login fails

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: My `login` function can fail. How do I report that?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Mark it `throws`, then throw an error for a wrong password.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Like this? I throw `LoginError.bad` inside the `if`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. Now the caller must write try before the call.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I forgot it, and the compiler shows an error.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. Try tells everyone this call can fail.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: But the app crashes on a wrong password.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Use do-catch. Put try in `do`, and handle the error in `catch`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So do-catch prints "Failed", and the app keeps running?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Throw it, try it, and do-catch it.
Throw an error when the password is wrong.
